words.word: unto me or give a reward

occurrences.text: Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?
words: unto me or Give a reward

occurrences.text: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.
